metrics.forward_actions: own selected action2 per role/family/episode with authenticated original public before and after, and source-public front object type/state
metrics.public_shift: replay unchanged MG48 projected() and align() at an arbitrary hypothesized zero origin (translation invariance), compare stationary and shifted exact matching counts
metrics.proxy_grounded: same MG48 frozen threshold shifted>=8 and shifted>=stationary+3; retain original episode classifier counts
metrics.blocked_from_public: source public front cell object type2 wall, object type4 door with state!=0 or object type5/6/7 object; do not assume any object type is physically traversable beyond original source semantics; report each distinct class separately
metrics.source_confirmed_nondisplacement: public before and after complete source observation SHA identical after action2; wall-front original Farama action2 cannot change agent position; other source-public changed cases not proof of movement
metrics.ambiguous: report front cell not immediately classified impassable, no direct physical-pose sensor; unsupported shifted image match is neither physical motion nor no motion
metrics.conflation: report explicit calibration crosstab proxy-grounded vs source-visible wall/closed-door/solid-object and exact full-public SHA; compute false-grounded lower bound only for source walls/closed doors under original actions; do NOT claim full classification accuracy
metrics.replay: replay per episode with original MG48 state reset and hypothesized offset advanced ONLY on prior proxy-grounded forward events. Validate episode logged grounded and ambiguous counts exactly; map across seeds is family source memory but episode-local pose resets
metrics.target_outcome: exact original per-family role positive goals, target visible and selected target effects, real door openings, override counts; validate archive's original summary
metrics.source_custody: verify byte ZIP SHA; authenticate both complete original source process canonical SHA and equality; all episode/event before/after and selected source-event hashes; 180 identities/33493 own selected actions; no new Farama actions

interpretation_limits: public local image and heading only; no privileged source pose, inventory, map or oracle
an apparent projected alignment is not verified physical localization
same-seed arms select different actions and are not identical decision states
no accepted scientific first use or transfer claim
